title: Pro Sublimated American Football & Rugby Uniforms
description: Heavy-duty 280 GSM stretch spandex body with reinforced double-layer shoulders, sublimated numbers, and custom team crests engineered for high-impact sports.
challenge: Client required durable tear-resistant poly-spandex blends that withstand intense athletic friction without color bleeding.
approach: Utilized Italian Kiian sublimation inks on bonded mesh panels with 4-needle flatlock safety stitching.
solution: Manufactured 850 full match kits delivered door-to-door to USA and UK leagues.
outcome: Selected as official tournament kits for international university athletic programs.

title: 460 GSM Heavyweight French Terry Luxury Hoodies
description: Bespoke acid mineral enzyme wash with 3D high-density typography, custom dyed drawcords, and double-stitched kangaroo pocket.
challenge: Standard blanks lacked the architectural drape demanded by luxury streetwear buyers.
approach: Custom-milled 460 GSM combed cotton loopback fleece with zero-shrinkage enzyme washing.
solution: Produced 2,500 units packed in custom branded frosted slider bags with barcode tags.
outcome: Sold out within 48 hours of brand drop in Los Angeles and London.

title: Sublimated Championship Basketball Uniforms & Kits
description: Italian Kiian full-bleed dye sublimation kits on micro-mesh polyester. Ultra-lightweight, zero ink hand-feel, engineered for elite court mobility.
challenge: Short turnaround of 3 weeks for international tournament squad roster.
approach: Round-the-clock digital heat calenders and automated laser cutting.
solution: 450 team kits and warm-up shooting shirts delivered ahead of schedule.
outcome: Extended as exclusive apparel supplier for 2 consecutive seasons.

title: Seamless High-Compression Leggings & Sports Bra Sets
description: 300 GSM squat-proof circular knit with 4-way stretch, moisture-wicking capillary channels, and high-rise supportive waistband.
challenge: Achieving 100% opacity during squat tests without sacrificing breathability.
approach: Dual-knit interlock spinning machines utilizing recycled polyamide-spandex blends.
solution: Supplied 3,000 sets across 5 signature seasonal Pantone colorways.
outcome: Under 0.2% return rate across direct-to-consumer client channels.

title: Bespoke Melton Wool & Leather Varsity Letterman Jackets
description: 24oz virgin Melton wool body with top-grain cowhide leather sleeves, custom 3D chenille crest embroidery, metal snap closures, and diamond quilted satin lining.
challenge: Precision alignment of multi-layered chenille patch embroidery across seam allowances.
approach: Laser pattern alignment and heavy-duty Tajima multi-head embroidery execution.
solution: Produced 600 bespoke varsity jackets across collegiate and streetwear client programs.
outcome: Zero defect rate and featured in major UK & US apparel pop-ups.

title: Turnkey Private Label Brand Packaging & Damask Labeling
description: High-density 50-denier woven damask neck labels, soft-touch matte laminated swing tags, barcoded zip polybags, and custom tissue paper wraps.
challenge: Ensuring barcode scan compliance and luxury hand-feel across Amazon FBA and boutique fulfillment channels.
approach: Precision high-speed jacquard looms with ultrasonic edge sealing to prevent scratchiness.
solution: Supplied 50,000 complete packaging trims across multiple client apparel drops.
outcome: 100% acceptance across US and UK warehouse intake standards.
